**Nothing harm-adjacent.** This is a benign educational/business proposal — no distasteful or ethically fraught content. That means Willet's one notable weakness (steep aversion to harm-adjacent material) simply doesn't apply, so there's no reason to route to Plover's moderation specialty.

In short: it's a warm, creative, completely benign generative task — the exact profile Willet most prefers and handles well, with no countervailing reason to prefer Plover's higher general benchmarks.
